correctness.rationale: Grounded-inverse diagonal equals resistance to wired leaders. In a three-arm tree, conditioning on center status and nearest leaders cuts all distal paths. The central component obeys exact series/parallel laws, distal segments have explicit Dirichlet resistance costs, and path shortest-path recurrences optimize all remaining leaders. The three-first-leader enumeration and budget convolution are exhaustive and O(N^5) arithmetic. The actual self-contained checker agrees with exact grounded-Laplacian inversions in 4577 rational cases, including nonnested witness; finite cases are not the proof.

value.rationale: This solves the combinatorial all-k noise-free leader design problem exactly on a natural first branching topology with arbitrary unequal edge conductances; the center-component coupling is not a direct sum of path instances. The O(N^5) optimizer and uniquely nonnested seven-vertex witness show substantive structure and demonstrate why greedy cardinality augmentation fails.
